assertions.name: the real RAST desktop boots against the native API contract
one shared client creates one RAST window per remote Xpra window
each top-level window has a taskbar entry
assertions.detail: File Station | Resource Monitor | Control Panel | xterm

assertions.name: native app launches from the RAST launcher
keyboard forwarding works in the real desktop (remote xterm ran the command)
RAST resize reaches the X server window
minimize iconifies the remote window (X11 unmap)
restore from the taskbar maps the remote window again
maximize resizes the remote window to the work area
closing a RAST window closes only that remote window
refresh reconnects and restores every window (no duplicated apps)
narrow (390x844) layout keeps native windows usable
App Center shows the Docker -> native migration notice
assertions.detail: Linux apps can run natively · 1 app still runs in a Docker container. Migrate to a native install for faster starts, less memory and real desktop windows.

assertions.name: App Center shows the native install details (badge, path, launcher, dependencies)
install preview presents package transaction + compatibility before installing
assertions.detail: google-chrome-stable, package changes, compatible, architecture, to install
